# Phase 1: iNaturalist Identifier Resolution

To retrieve observations, you must first resolve common names or place names into iNaturalist IDs.

### Taxon IDs
Use `pyinaturalist.get_taxa` to find species or group IDs.
- **Function**: `pyinaturalist.get_taxa(q="Name", rank="species")`
- **Resolution**: Search results are in `['results']`. Match the `['name']` (scientific name) or check `['preferred_common_name']`.
- **Example**: "Monarch Butterfly" -> `48662`.

### Place IDs
Use `pyinaturalist.get_places_autocomplete` to find geographic IDs.
- **Function**: `pyinaturalist.get_places_autocomplete(q="Place Name")`
- **Resolution**: Results are in `['results']`. Use the `['id']` of the most relevant entry (check `['display_name']`).
- **Example**: "California" -> `14`.

### Summary Table (Common Values)
| Name | Type | ID |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Monarch Butterfly | Taxon | 48662 |
| California, US | Place | 14 |
| Research Grade | Quality | `research` |
| Needs ID | Quality | `needs_id` |
